name: com.kerbtape/weekend-board
title: KerbTape weekend board
description: Read-only data on Hyperliquid stock, index and pre-IPO perps: closes, weekend gaps, reopens, history

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Find Hyperliquid markets (HIP-3 stocks, indices, commodities, pre-IPO, and crypto) by name, ticker or alias. Returns coin ids (for example xyz:NVDA) to pass to the other tools.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: One Hyperliquid market now: price, last official close, gap vs that close, when real pricing resumes, funding, open interest, price band. Pre-IPO markets come back flagged, without a close.

coin.description: A coin id like xyz:NVDA, a ticker like NVDA, or a name like Nvidia or gold.

tools.name: get_last_close
tools.description: The last official close KerbTape uses for a market: price, time, venue and how it was captured (oracle at the close minute, or estimated from Hyperliquid trades).

coin.description: A coin id like xyz:NVDA, a ticker like NVDA, or a name like Nvidia or gold.

tools.name: get_weekend_gaps
tools.description: The weekend or overnight gap: markets whose home exchange is shut now (nights, weekends, holidays), by their gap vs its last close, largest first, with when real pricing resumes. Markets trading in a real session (cash, extended, overnight) come back apart under moving_now, with their move since the last close, which is not a gap. Optional group: us_stocks, etfs, indices, commodities, korea, japan, china_hk, india, fx, other.

tools.name: get_reopen_times
tools.description: When each market group's real pricing resumes (overnight session, futures, cash open), in UTC and New York time, and each home exchange's session state.

tools.name: get_scorecard
tools.description: The Monday scorecard, as /scorecard leads with it: headline = the weekly scorecard (on how many board markets Hyperliquid's weekend price was closer to the reopen than Friday's close, with the median errors); then, labelled, our posts graded at each market's first real print and the running rate over every weekend. Each with its definition. History, not a forecast.

tools.name: get_ipo
tools.description: An IPO board (default ANT, Anthropic): offer range with its filing and source, pricing and first trade dates with their status, and Hyperliquid's pre-IPO market as data.

tools.name: get_preipo_markets
tools.description: Every pre-IPO perp listed on Hyperliquid's HIP-3 deployers, with mark, implied valuation where a share count is on record, and listing status. Data only.

tools.name: get_market_history
tools.description: One market's graded weekends, newest first: the last close before the weekend, Hyperliquid's weekend price 5 minutes before real pricing returned, the actual reopen, the grade (was the weekend price closer to the reopen than the close?) and the dates, plus the market's hit rate with its 95% interval. The same rows as /history and /scorecard. Paginated (page, limit up to 52). History, not a forecast; pre-IPO markets have no graded weekend.

coin.description: A coin id like xyz:NVDA, a ticker like NVDA, or a name like Nvidia or gold.

tools.name: get_fees
tools.description: KerbTape's builder fee schedule (basis points by tier and market class, the approved maximum), added on top of Hyperliquid's own fees. The data board is free.
